priorRole.scope: Exact duplicate of accepted development-public allocation0.1:16 schema1 records1493..1508 and reused namespace1155. Independent Learning/Formation flags and roots preserve skill/belief versus personality authorship. Optional report/estimate preserves absent versus negative/known zero. Formation entry preserves event-time phase, gain, contribution and applied delta, not refolding when age changes. DiagnosticRow data is diagnostic output, not a writable cognitive leaf. Field names/types are backing declarations; ownership, ordered execution, safe observation and restoration require the separately qualified contract/runtime. Immutable constitution is separate and has no new writer. Controlled phase0..4 is not calendar ageing or a universal developmental law.
